prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 二维合并 · 采购评审 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "甲、乙两家报价接近，建议进入第二轮商务谈判，重点" spans 1 col × 2 row; "未按要求提交完整报价文件，视为无效投标" spans 3 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "供应商" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "报价" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 65px
  col 3: header "交期" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 38px
  col 4: header "质保" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "评审意见" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 582px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录采购评审中各供应商的报价、交期、质保和评审结论，支持比较及筛选。","reading":"按行查看各供应商的情况，并纵向比较报价、交期和质保；甲、乙两行共用评审意见，丙的无效投标说明横跨三个指标列。","groups":["报价、交期和质保是并列的采购指标，宜保持紧凑且便于纵向比较。","供应商与评审意见分别标识评审对象和结论；甲、乙的合并意见关联两行，应作为共同结论阅读。"],"keep_intact":["供应商名称","报价金额及货币符号","交期和质保数值及单位","列标题"],"may_wrap":["甲、乙两家的长评审意见可自然换行，其合并单元格可利用两行的总高度。","丙的无效投标说明可在横跨的三个指标列内自然换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [64, 86, 52, 48, 469] · table 720×239px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [76, 110, 75, 75, 383] · table 720×169px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [68, 94, 60, 55, 442] · table 720×169px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"报价保持完整；较宽的评审意见列让共同结论舒展，并清楚地关联甲、乙两行。","problems":"供应商名称、部分列标题以及交期和质保的数值与单位被拆成两行，削弱了逐行阅读和纵向比较。四行都因此显得过高。","cause":"供应商列64px、交期列52px和质保列48px扣除内边距及边框后过窄；评审意见列469px占用了过多宽度。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"标题、供应商名称和指标值均保持完整，三项指标易于纵向比较；共同评审意见分两行，阅读清楚。","problems":"指标列略显宽松，评审意见列相对紧张，长意见和丙的无效投标说明都换成两行。","cause":"报价列110px、交期和质保列各75px占用了较多宽度，使评审意见列为383px；丙的说明受三个指标列合计260px的限制。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"标题、供应商名称和指标值保持完整；指标列紧凑，评审意见列较宽，共同结论分两行且留白较舒展。","problems":"交期和质保列较窄，数值靠近边界；丙的说明在“文件”一词中间换行，影响阅读。","cause":"交期列60px和质保列55px接近内容所需宽度；三个指标列合计209px，使跨列说明在不理想的位置换行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[70,100,68,62,419],"change":"以r0C为基础，给交期、质保和跨列说明更多空间，同时保留较宽的评审意见列，改善指标的呼吸感和丙行的换行位置。"},{"name":"wide-merged","widths":[70,110,75,70,394],"change":"扩大三个指标列的合计宽度，尝试让丙的跨列说明在更自然的位置换行，同时保持共同评审意见有足够空间。"},{"name":"compact-metrics","widths":[70,96,64,60,429],"change":"在r0C的紧凑结构上略加宽指标列，将剩余空间留给评审意见，检验指标间距与共同结论的平衡。"}]}
